title: DSPy Program Optimizers
summary: This module provides a collection of advanced teleprompters (optimizers) for DSPy programs. These optimizers employ various strategies, including iterative prompt refinement, few-shot example selection, reinforcement learning, and meta-optimization, to enhance program performance and efficiency.

nodes.label: Refine Instructions with Feedback
nodes.title: Avatar Optimizer
nodes.description: Iteratively refines a program's instructions based on positive and negative examples, using a comparator and a feedback-based instruction generator.

nodes.label: Compare Program Performance
nodes.title: Comparator Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that takes positive and negative examples, along with current instructions and actions, to generate feedback for improving performance.

nodes.label: Generate New Instructions from Feedback
nodes.title: Feedback Instruction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that takes previous instructions and feedback to generate new, improved instructions for a program.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Optimization Strategies
nodes.title: BetterTogether Meta-Optimizer
nodes.description: A meta-optimizer that combines prompt and weight optimization strategies in configurable sequences, allowing iterative improvement of both prompts and model parameters.

nodes.label: Capture Execution Traces & Handle Errors
nodes.title: Patched Forward
nodes.description: A patched forward method for DSPy programs that captures execution traces and handles adapter parsing errors by logging failures and assigning a FailedPrediction object.

nodes.label: Iterative Prompt Refinement
nodes.title: COPRO Optimizer
nodes.description: Iteratively refines prompt instructions and prefixes for a DSPy program by generating multiple candidates, evaluating them, and using the best ones to inform subsequent generations.

nodes.label: Generate Basic Instructions
nodes.title: Basic Instruction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for generating initial or basic instructions and output field prefixes for a language model.

nodes.label: Refine Instructions from Attempts
nodes.title: Instruction Refinement Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that takes a list of previously attempted instructions and their scores to propose new, improved instructions and output field prefixes.

nodes.label: Evolve Prompts with Reflection
nodes.title: GEPA Optimizer
nodes.description: An evolutionary optimizer that uses reflection to evolve text components of complex systems, guiding prompt evolution with textual feedback from a metric function.

nodes.label: Define GEPA Feedback Metric
nodes.title: GEPA Feedback Metric Protocol
nodes.description: A protocol defining the interface for a metric function used by GEPA, which can provide scores and textual feedback at both program and predictor levels.

nodes.label: Propose Multimodal Instructions
nodes.title: Multimodal Instruction Proposer
nodes.description: A GEPA-compatible instruction proposer that handles multimodal inputs by using a single-component proposer for each component needing updates.

nodes.label: Enhance Multimodal Instructions
nodes.title: Enhanced Multimodal Instruction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for generating improved multimodal instructions based on feedback, focusing on visual analysis, text integration, and domain-specific knowledge.

nodes.label: Fine-tune LMs with Reinforcement Learning
nodes.title: GRPO Optimizer
nodes.description: A Reinforcement Learning-based optimizer that fine-tunes language models by collecting trajectories from a student program and teachers, then training the LM with rewards based on a metric.

nodes.label: Induce & Apply Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: InferRules Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that induces natural language rules from examples and incorporates them into a program's instructions to improve performance.

nodes.label: Generate Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: Custom Rules Induction Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for generating concise natural language rules from a set of examples.

nodes.label: Select K-NN Few-Shot Examples
nodes.title: KNNFewShot Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that dynamically selects k-nearest neighbor examples from a trainset at test time to use as few-shot demonstrations for a student module.

nodes.label: Bayesian Prompt & Few-Shot Optimization
nodes.title: MIPROv2 Optimizer
nodes.description: A meta-optimizer that combines bootstrapping few-shot examples with instruction proposal and Bayesian optimization (using Optuna) to find optimal prompt parameters for a DSPy program.

nodes.label: Self-Improving Stochastic Optimizer
nodes.title: SIMBA Optimizer
nodes.description: A stochastic introspective optimizer that uses an LLM to analyze its own performance, generate improvement rules, or add successful examples as demonstrations.

nodes.label: Append Rule to Predictor
nodes.title: Append Rule Utility
nodes.description: A utility function for SIMBA that generates and appends a new rule to a predictor's instructions based on contrasting good and bad execution trajectories.

nodes.label: Append Demo to Predictor
nodes.title: Append Demo Utility
nodes.description: A utility function for SIMBA that appends a successful example from a good execution trajectory as a few-shot demonstration to a predictor.

nodes.label: Generate Module-Specific Advice
nodes.title: OfferFeedback Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by SIMBA to generate advice for program modules by contrasting good and bad execution trajectories.

nodes.label: Optimize Few-Shot Sets with Optuna
nodes.title: BootstrapFewShot with Optuna
nodes.description: An optimizer that combines BootstrapFewShot for generating candidate few-shot sets with Optuna for Bayesian optimization to select the best set of demonstrations.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Module
nodes.title: DSPy Module
nodes.description: The fundamental building block of a DSPy program, representing a callable component that can contain predictors.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input/output fields and instructions for a language model call within a DSPy predictor.

nodes.label: DSPy Example
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: A data structure representing a single input-output pair used for training or evaluation.

nodes.label: Language Model Client
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: An interface for interacting with various language models, handling API calls and responses.

nodes.label: Program Evaluator
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluate
nodes.description: A utility for evaluating DSPy programs against a dataset using a specified metric.

nodes.label: Text Embedder
nodes.title: DSPy Embedder
nodes.description: A component for converting text into numerical vector representations (embeddings).

nodes.label: Optuna Optimization Library
nodes.title: Optuna
nodes.description: A hyperparameter optimization framework used for automating search processes.

nodes.label: GEPA Optimization Library
nodes.title: GEPA Library
nodes.description: The external GEPA library providing the core evolutionary optimization engine.

nodes.label: Base Teleprompter
nodes.title: Base Teleprompter
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all DSPy optimizers, defining the common interface for program compilation.

nodes.label: DSPy Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Predictor
nodes.description: A module that wraps a language model call with a specific signature, potentially including few-shot examples.

nodes.label: DSPy Context Manager
nodes.title: DSPy Context
nodes.description: Manages global DSPy settings and state, such as the active language model or trace.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.title: DSPy Settings
nodes.description: Global configuration settings for DSPy, including default LMs, cache behavior, and error handling.

nodes.label: Parallel Execution Utility
nodes.title: DSPy Parallel
nodes.description: Utility for running DSPy program executions in parallel across multiple threads.

nodes.label: Typed Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Typed Predictor
nodes.description: A specialized predictor that enforces type-hinted input and output fields.

nodes.label: Basic Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Predict
nodes.description: A basic predictor module that takes a signature and uses an LM to generate an output.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Few-Shot Optimizer
nodes.title: BootstrapFewShot
nodes.description: An optimizer that bootstraps few-shot examples for a program.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Finetune Optimizer
nodes.title: BootstrapFinetune
nodes.description: An optimizer that fine-tunes a language model based on bootstrapped examples.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Few-Shot with Random Search
nodes.title: BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch
nodes.description: An optimizer that bootstraps few-shot examples using random search.

nodes.label: Grounded Instruction Proposer
nodes.title: GroundedProposer
nodes.description: A component that proposes instructions based on program code, data summaries, and few-shot examples.

nodes.label: K-Nearest Neighbors Retriever
nodes.title: DSPy KNN
nodes.description: A utility for finding k-nearest neighbors in a dataset based on embeddings.

nodes.label: Base Finetune Teleprompter
nodes.title: Base Finetune Teleprompter
nodes.description: An abstract base class for teleprompters that involve fine-tuning language models.

nodes.label: Adapter Parsing Error
nodes.title: AdapterParseError
nodes.description: An error raised when an adapter fails to parse the language model's response.

nodes.label: Failed Prediction Object
nodes.title: FailedPrediction
nodes.description: A special object representing a prediction that failed due to parsing or other issues.

groups.label: Core Prompt Optimizers
groups.title: Core Prompt Optimizers
groups.description: Optimizers focused on refining program instructions and prompts through iterative or evolutionary methods.

groups.label: Rule & Few-Shot Induction
groups.title: Rule & Few-Shot Induction
groups.description: Optimizers that derive natural language rules or dynamically select few-shot examples to improve program performance.

groups.label: Self-Improving & RL Optimizers
groups.title: Self-Improving & RL Optimizers
groups.description: Optimizers that leverage self-reflection or reinforcement learning to continuously improve program behavior and underlying language models.

groups.label: Meta-Optimization Orchestration
groups.title: Meta-Optimization Orchestration
groups.description: An optimizer that orchestrates and combines multiple optimization strategies (e.g., prompt and weight optimization) in a configurable sequence.

groups.label: Instruction & Feedback Signatures
groups.title: Instruction & Feedback Signatures
groups.description: DSPy Signatures used for generating, refining, or enhancing instructions and providing structured feedback for optimization processes.

groups.label: Feedback Analysis Utilities
groups.title: Feedback Analysis Utilities
groups.description: Components and protocols for analyzing program performance, defining feedback mechanisms, and generating instructions based on comparative analysis.

groups.label: Instruction Proposal Utilities
groups.title: Instruction Proposal Utilities
groups.description: Utility functions for proposing and appending new instructions, rules, or demonstrations to predictors based on execution trajectories.

groups.label: Execution Trace & Error Handling
groups.title: Execution Trace & Error Handling
groups.description: A utility for capturing detailed execution traces of DSPy programs and gracefully handling parsing errors during runtime.
